entities.summary: Vrhnika is a town in Slovenia. It is the seat of the Municipality of Vrhnika. It is located on the Ljubljanica River, 21 km from Ljubljana along the A1 motorway. Vrhnika is a city in Southern Europe. A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
